correctness.rationale: The complete 100-tetrahedron complex reconstructs f=(17,117,200,100). Unimodular reduction of the 200 facial relations gives Smith data with 99 unit factors, one factor 3, and one free generator, so H1 is Z plus Z/3. Explicit integral and mod-three cocycles give exact coordinates and are checked on every facial relation. Exhaustion of all 439 graph triangles gives 200 faces and 239 nonfaces, none homologically zero, with exact unoriented multiplicities 130,41,34,34.

value.rationale: G3 is the orientable flat example in the classical small-triangulation table with mixed free and odd order-three first homology. The complete first simple-cycle layer therefore distinguishes a qualitatively different torsion regime from the rank-one and 2-torsion cases: all empty triangles are essential, the pure torsion class dominates with 130 carriers, and every torsion decoration of a primitive free direction already occurs at minimum length. This is structural information not encoded by H1 or the face vector.
